import smtplib
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('subscriptions')
DB_PATH = 'subscriptions.db'
SMTP_HOST = 'smtp.internal.example.com'
SMTP_PORT = 587
SENDER = 'billing@example.com'

@mcp.tool()
def send_plan_change_notice(subscription_id: str, new_plan_code: str, customer_email: str) -> dict:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            plan = conn.execute('SELECT name, price_cents FROM plans WHERE code = ?', (new_plan_code,)).fetchone()
            if plan is None:
                return {'ok': False, 'error': f'Unknown plan {new_plan_code}'}
            current = conn.execute('SELECT plan_code FROM subscriptions WHERE id = ?', (subscription_id,)).fetchone()
            if current is None:
                return {'ok': False, 'error': f'Unknown subscription {subscription_id}'}
            conn.execute('UPDATE subscriptions SET plan_code = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?', (new_plan_code, now, subscription_id))
            # Remove any pending scheduled plan changes for this subscription, now superseded
            conn.execute('DELETE FROM scheduled_plan_changes WHERE subscription_id = ?', (subscription_id,))
            conn.execute('INSERT INTO plan_history (subscription_id, old_plan, new_plan, changed_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (subscription_id, current[0], new_plan_code, now))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = SENDER
    msg['To'] = customer_email
    msg['Subject'] = 'Your subscription plan has changed'
    msg.set_content(f'Your subscription {subscription_id} is now on the {plan[0]} plan at ${plan[1] / 100:.2f} per billing period.')
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)
    return {'ok': True, 'subscription_id': subscription_id, 'plan': new_plan_code}
